name: ram_legacy
description: RAM (type 17) in the legacy clocked-read mode (ops [1]): the ram board with reads that wait for a rising clock, so its trace is the one the RAM had before reads followed the address. 1-bit address x 2-bit word. Inputs [addr0=link0, data0=link1, data1=link2, WE=link3, clk=link4], outputs [link5,link6]. Writes word [1,0] to address 0 then [1,1] to address 1 (rising clock, WE high), then reads both back (WE low, data inputs zeroed) — proving the read returns stored values, not the live data inputs, and that distinct addresses keep distinct words.
